content.text:
Read this turn from the gateway's own files:

1. The free tier allows 60 requests per minute (gateway/config/rate_limits.yaml:4).
2. Its burst allowance is 10 requests (gateway/config/rate_limits.yaml:5).
3. Access tokens last 3600 seconds (gateway/src/auth.py:3).
4. The gateway issues no refresh tokens; a client requests a new token when one expires (gateway/src/auth.py:4).
5. The free tier includes 10,000 calls a month (gateway/docs/pricing.md:5, last updated 2026-10-01).

I am also assuming the nightly sync is the only client using this API key; nothing in the repository says so.
